name: ClaudeSkills
headline: ClaudeSkills for LLM-driven workflows
short_description: A Claude Skill collection designed for task automation, document parsing, and intelligent dispatch. such as utilities for webpage-to-Markdown conversion, API doc parsing, and structured JSON extraction. optimized for LLM-driven workflows
author: kay-ou

sections.overview:
ClaudeSkills is a modular collection of Claude Skills designed to streamline document processing, data extraction, and task automation. It includes utilities for converting web pages to clean Markdown, parsing Markdown into structured JSON, and developing quantitative trading strategies with API guardrails. Each skill is self-contained with clear interfaces and comprehensive error handling, enabling developers to automate complex workflows efficiently. The collection follows progressive disclosure patterns and includes bilingual support for enhanced trigger accuracy.
Convert web pages to Markdown for content archival and LLM processing
Parse Markdown documents into structured JSON for data extraction
Develop and validate PTrade trading strategies with API constraints
Create and package new Claude Skills following best practices
